tasks.short: Grade logs against observable characteristics and established standards

steps.what: Inspect logs for knot size, straightness and other characteristics required by the applicable grade
inputs: applicable company or industry grading standard

steps.what: Consult the applicable grade criteria and resolve which grade the observed log satisfies
inputs: applicable company or industry grading standard
outputs: operator's selected log grade under the applicable standard

steps.what: Enter and check the selected grade against the correct log identifier in the grading tally
inputs: operator's selected log grade under the applicable standard

steps.what: Save the checked grade entry in the same tally

tasks.design: Keep physical grading and the associated tally in {OPS_SYSTEM} with the applicable standard in {DOCS}. Native grade choices already support entry in this scenario; volume measurement does not supply knot size, straightness or a defensible quality grade.
tasks.previous_blocker: The grade depends on actual log characteristics and the chosen standard.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability is established beyond the existing standard view and tally choices.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing defects and applying the correct quality threshold.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize uncertain or borderline log characteristics.

ambition.what: No automatic log quality grading from volume data.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: log quality grading uses observed characteristics and grading criteria; volume computation does not establish those quality characteristics.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the operator's existing log tally. This scenario includes the associated grade entry, explicitly split from inspection and judgement; a physical grade mark would likewise remain manual.
Operator supplies actual observations and grade; the log identifier is read from the existing tally or log label. No sensor-generated knot or straightness data is assumed.
Native standards view and grade choices are already available. Shares are provisional, not measured; no additional saving is supported, including the same-system save.
unknowns: Whether grades are marked physically or recorded against log identifiers locally
research_questions: Observe inspection, standards lookup and grade entry to identify any genuine duplicate tally.

already_counted.description: Enter and check the selected grade against the actual log

approvals.approved_version: complete checked log-grade entry at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Inspection, standards interpretation and native tally entry all retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Complete required job or shift report forms

steps.what: Gather the actual shift identity, machine counter readings and operator-observed work and exception details
inputs: actual machine counters and shift identifiers
operator's actual work and exception observations
outputs: source-checked shift facts with missing fields identified

steps.what: Transfer existing machine and shift fields into the required report and verify the populated values against their source
inputs: source-checked shift facts with missing fields identified
outputs: source-checked routine report fields; absent values left blank

steps.what: Complete required job or shift report narrative and unresolved fields using actual observations
inputs: source-checked routine report fields; absent values left blank
source-checked shift facts with missing fields identified
outputs: completed job or shift report draft

steps.what: Check the completed report for correct shift, units, omissions and consistency with observed work
inputs: completed job or shift report draft
source-checked shift facts with missing fields identified
outputs: final checked job or shift report

steps.what: Save the final checked report in the same reporting system
inputs: final checked job or shift report

tasks.design: Configure the native shift form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to populate fields already held by the machine's reporting system. The operator verifies these fields, supplies actual exceptions and missing facts, checks the complete report and saves it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A required report may require copying routine machine fields even when their sources already exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report configuration can map existing counter and shift fields without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining stoppages and exceptions that counters do not describe.
tasks.human_edge: Report what actually happened and identify misleading machine readings.

ambition.what: Reduce duplicate field entry in the existing report.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7; operator consultation and access approval for machine shift data

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: machine counters and shift identifiers can populate configured report fields; operators still supply exception accounts and verify the report.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is machine production and shift reporting software. Its existing counters and shift identifiers produce routine source fields; s1 checks sources and captures exceptions. No new structured observation form is hidden.

Native form configuration first. If the report already populates routine fields or counter meanings do not match, no saving is claimed. No automated narrative or separate submission is assumed by 'fill out'.

Shares are provisional scenarios, not observed baselines. Gross 10 minus 1 upkeep gives 9 net; native machine runtime is not labor and the 1% same-system save is fully retained. Final report checking is ordinary existing authoring work, not a new approval layer.
unknowns: Actual report field definitions, available counter fields and duplicated entry time
research_questions: Which mandatory fields are actually re-keyed and can native mappings preserve units, shift boundaries and missing-data flags?

already_counted.description: Verify populated fields and final report

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and check changes in machine counter definitions

approvals.approved_version: final checked report at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if already native; cautious range below provisional 9% net pending observed re-keying.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Machine reporting administrator can configure existing shift fields; no quality-grading decision moves to software.
skills_to_grow: Check source units and shift boundaries
Distinguish quality grades from volume measures
Record actual exceptions without inferred causes
role.ambitious_version: Keep physical grading with the operator and reduce verified duplicate entry in the required shift report.
